name: Dulevo
legalEntityNote: Dulevo is operated by the Italian company Dulevo International S.p.A. within FAYAT Group and FAYAT Environmental Solutions. Regional Dulevo companies, dealers, vehicle homologation parties and service organizations can hold separate responsibilities.
headline: Dulevo industrial and urban sweepers, FAYAT ownership and buyer checks
description: A source-backed profile of Dulevo International, its FAYAT ownership, Italian production, industrial and street-cleaning portfolio, global dealer network and machine-level checks.
metaDescription: Dulevo profile: FAYAT ownership, Italian company, industrial and street sweepers, scrubbers, production, dealers and buyer checks.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Dulevo or FAYAT. Group ownership and company-level production statements do not establish the origin, homologation, importer or warranty terms of every machine.

contentVisuals.alt: FAYAT Group Dulevo International and regional service responsibility boundary
contentVisuals.caption: FAYAT owns Dulevo, but the Italian operating company, regional seller, homologation party and warranty provider remain separate roles.

contentVisuals.alt: Dulevo application configuration compliance and lifecycle verification checklist
contentVisuals.caption: Industrial and road-cleaning machines need application, configuration, compliance and service checks at model and destination-market level.

ownership.summary: Dulevo's official history says FAYAT Group acquired the company in 2021. Dulevo now operates within FAYAT Environmental Solutions while Dulevo International S.p.A. remains the named Italian company on the official site and privacy materials.

productPortfolio.name: Industrial sweepers
productPortfolio.positioning: Walk-behind and ride-on machines for factories, logistics, heavy industry and dusty working environments.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Specify debris, dust class, filtration, aisle width, gradient, unloading method, power source and working hours.

productPortfolio.name: Street sweepers
productPortfolio.positioning: Compact and high-capacity municipal sweepers spanning electric, diesel and alternative-fuel configurations.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Verify road homologation, emissions stage, noise, axle load, driving licence, seasonal duty and local parts support.

productPortfolio.name: Scrubber-dryers and combination machines
productPortfolio.positioning: BOOST scrubbers and combined sweep-scrub platforms cover commercial and industrial floorcare duties.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Match floor type, cleaning width, tanks, chemical compatibility, brush system, drying result and practical productivity.

productPortfolio.name: Street washers and specialist vehicles
productPortfolio.positioning: Road-washing and specialist variants extend the portfolio into urban sanitation and municipal operations.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Treat chassis, attachments, water systems, vehicle approvals and service requirements as a configured machine rather than a generic brand purchase.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Dulevo's 50-year company page describes a 20,000-square-metre production footprint and traces company-owned production to Italy.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Confirm the manufacturer, assembly site, vehicle identification, origin and production date for the exact machine.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The company history says Dulevo acquired Tecnosystem in 2020 as a production hub for truck-mounted products.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Do not extend that statement to compact, industrial or scrubber product families without model documentation.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: The official Dulevo 6000 page publishes machine-level dimensions, power supply, filtration and performance specifications.
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Freeze the exact engine, emissions stage, brushes, options, homologation and destination-market documentation in the tender.

marketsChannels.evidence: Dulevo reports operations in more than 80 countries and positions itself across commercial, industrial and urban cleaning.
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Identify the authorized local dealer, importing entity and service territory for the machine before award.

marketsChannels.evidence: The official site provides dealer-finding, assistance, product registration, used-equipment and rental routes.
marketsChannels.scope: Dulevo's published channel and service framework
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm which services are actually available locally and record technician coverage, parts stock, response time and training.

marketsChannels.evidence: Dulevo says its machines serve municipal authorities as well as cement, mining and other demanding industrial applications.
marketsChannels.scope: Reference applications rather than guaranteed suitability
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Require an application survey, demonstration and duty-cycle calculation using the buyer's debris, dust, route and climate.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Dulevo combines specialist sweeping technology with a broad industrial and municipal vehicle range and FAYAT's road-equipment context. Procurement risk sits in configuration and local execution: emissions, homologation, attachments, filtration, application duty and dealer support can change the delivered result materially.
